title: Declaration Base Information Package — val
description: Details related to any statement or action, in any form prescribed or accepted by the Government Agency, giving information or particulars required by the Governmental Agency.

issue.description: Date and time the document was issued and when appropriate, signed or otherwise authenticated.

issueLocation.description: Identification of the location at which a document was issued and when appropriate, signed or otherwise authenticated.

invoice.description: Amount indicating the total of all invoice amounts in a single declaration.

loadingList.description: Quantity specifying the number of loading lists, manifests or similar documents.

currencyType.description: Code specifying a monetary unit or currency.

items.description: Details related to rate at which one specified currency is expressed in another specified currency.

transactionNature.description: Code specifying the nature of a transaction associated with a shipment.
transactionNature.x-wco-code-list:
WCO code + User codes.

* First digit indicates WCO code table value;
* Second digit can be used as additional User code to further define first digit

items.description: Details related to the special request from declarant to government to take or not to take action.

exitToEntryCharge.description: Amount indicating the total cost of freight, insurance and all other costs and expenses from the foreign exit location to the entry location.

freightCharge.description: Amount indicating the total costs incurred by the shipper in moving goods, by whatever means, from one place to another under the terms of the contract of carriage. In addition to transport costs, this may include such elements as packing, documentation, loading, unloading, and insurance (i.e., to the extent that they relate to the freight cost).

freightChargeApportionment.description: Code specifying the method of the proportional allocation of freight charges for each consignment in a multi consignment declaration .

method.description: Code specifying the method on which the customs value is determined.

partyRelationship.description: Code specifying the effect of relationship existing between two parties such as financial relationship.

paymentTerms.description: Code specifying the terms of payment expressed in international terms (e.g., Cash on Delivery (COD), 30/60/90 due dates, discounts, commissions) under which transaction is completed.

chargesType.description: Code specifying the type of charge or deduction.

otherChargeDeduction.description: Amount added or subtracted from the total invoice price (depending on the trade terms) not previously taken into account when determining the customs value.

loading.description: Date and time of initial loading onto a ship or airplane during one journey from export location to import location.
